posts.title: Logout Must Kill the Session
bullets: Invalidate the active session server-side when users log out.
Expire the session cookie and remove the browser's session identifier.
Replay the old session after logout; authenticated access must be denied.
posts.takeaway: A hidden button is not a revoked session.
posts.caption:
Logging out should end access, not just hide the session in a browser. Invalidate server-side sessions, expire cookies, and replay the old session identifier in testing. If it still works, logout is broken.
